slice: RPP-5ml selected consumed MLINESTYLE append source counts
scope: Adds runtime-generated AC1027 evidence for appending one tuple to consumed MLINESTYLE source counts 13, 16, 32, 64 and 128, producing targets 14, 17, 33, 65 and 129 respectively. The writer is unchanged. These selected profiles do not imply support for other counts, native semantics or whole-document conversion.

contract.admission: For each source count, the runtime-authored style contains offsets generated by consumedAppendOffset, ACI values generated by consumedAppendColor and alternating ByLayer/Continuous linetypes. The append adds exactly one element with the next generated tuple. Source and target flags are 2 and angles are equal. Two source-bound, open, uncut and unfilled MLINE consumers reference the style.
contract.geometry: The source recipe recalculates every source group-41 pair against the full source minimum. The selected append transaction recalculates every target pair against the full target minimum. Consumers have positive finite scale, center/bottom justification, unit extrusion, source-consistent positions/directions/miters, two segment parameters per element, zero second values, absent group 42 and zero area-fill counts.
contract.identityAndOutput: The MLINESTYLE keeps its source identity and emits the exact target group-71 count, ordered group-49 offsets, ACI values and linetype names. Unique ByLayer and Continuous LTYPE providers are checked. Both consumers retain the source style identity and group 340 target; each emits the target group-73 count and exact group-74/group-41/group-75 arrays. Fresh import checks every target tuple and both consumer parameter arrays and geometry in model space and a named block.
contract.failureAndRetry: An unsupported style flag refuses before publication and preserves the destination and caller snapshot; restoring flag 2 allows same-adapter retry. A late mutation to a live consumer parameter refuses before publication; restoring captured state allows same-adapter retry. Both controls are exercised in ASCII and binary output.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. AC1027 sources and outputs are authored at runtime and removed after success; no DWG/DXF fixtures are committed.
contract.limits: Evidence is limited to source-to-target profiles 13→14, 16→17, 32→33, 64→65 and 128→129 with the generated tuple patterns, flags, angles and two qualified consumers. Other source counts, target counts, append batches, removals, composed edits, MLINE schemas/carriers/versions, native rendering and document closure remain separate. No support claim is promoted. An exploratory 254→255 append attempt was refused during MLINE original redundant-name/reference preflight; its cause is unresolved and it is not a qualified refusal boundary.

controls.failureAndRetry: Per profile: four successful source/output combinations and eight readbacks; two unsupported-flag refusals, two late-consumer-mutation refusals, and four corrected same-adapter retries.

focusedSelector.summary: Five selected source-count profiles passed: 20 successful source/output combinations, 40 readbacks, 10 unsupported-flag refusals, 10 late-mutation refusals and 20 corrected same-adapter retries.

exploratoryBoundary.note: This probe was excluded from the positive selector after refusal. The underlying cause has not been isolated; do not treat it as an intended or complete refusal guarantee.
